what: The core of Pattern organs #5: propose patterns from a domain's cases, keep only those that predict HELD-OUT cases graded by a deterministic rule (balanced accuracy). A pattern survives only if it generalises.

claims.text: The real signal pattern generalises — it scores perfectly on held-out data
A non-generalising pattern is REJECTED on the held-out split
Overfit is caught — on a domain with no real pattern, NOTHING clears the bar
The signal is the only high-confidence survivor (held-out BA > 0.9)
